title: liparis clypeolum
intro: Liparis clypeolum, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical forests in Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Liparis clypeolum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
